sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: Six robbers armed with guns boarded a tanker underway. They entered the engine room and took the C/E and 3/E as hostage and tied them up in the engine room. Both C/E and 3/E managed to escape and immediately informed Bridge. Alarm raised, ship’s horn sounded and crew mustered. Seeing the alerted crew, the robbers escaped empty handed. The incident reported to VTIS. All crew safe are reported safe.
